entries.title: GRAVEN

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: GRAVEN left Early Access first on Windows PC, with PS4, PS5, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S ports following later. The PC version remains the best fidelity/capture/input route and no platform-exclusive content is sourced.
primary.how_to_play: Buy GRAVEN on Steam, GOG, or Epic Games Store for Windows PC and use the current full-release build.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC full release after Early Access.
all_releases.reason: primary: original full-release route and best fidelity/capture/input path.
